period_note: SOUTH BANGLA AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). CONSOLIDATED basis (same structure as this bank's own 2022_Q1.json; includes subsidiary SBAC Bank Investment Limited). No Solo alternative presented in this interim filing. Total assets (102,113,606,205), total liabilities (91,564,438,604), shareholders' equity attributable to the Bank's own owners (10,548,758,541) and non-controlling interest (409,060, still immaterial at 0.004% of total equity) all reconcile exactly (equity components sum to 10,548,758,541 exactly; + NCI = TOTAL SHAREHOLDERS' EQUITY of 10,549,167,601 = total_assets minus total_liabilities). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2022 (H1); this filing also prints discrete 'April to June' columns for both years, not used here (only the cumulative column is used, per this dataset's standing convention). Provision shortfall (Note 8.5, same Bangladesh Bank letter DOS(CAMS)1157/41(dividend)/2022-2224 already found in this bank's own 2022_Q1.json) was essentially FLAT at Tk.409.47m (vs Tk.409.47m at 31-Mar-2022 -- the Bank's own footnote states it 'has already maintained deficit provision of Tk.37,224,491 and the remaining balance of Tk.409,469,449 as on 30 June 2022 shall be maintained within the stipulated time prescribed by Bangladesh Bank', i.e. incremental provisioning this quarter exactly offset the growth in the required-provision base, leaving the deferred shortfall unchanged in absolute terms). Classified loans (Note 8.6) grew to Tk.4,180,473,288 (NPL 5.87%, up from 5.57% at 31-Mar-2022). No capital-adequacy disclosure in this filing.
